names.note: From «Άγιοι Αειθαλάς και Αμών» in this folder's Greek citation — the pair, and this is his half of it.
Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 3 noiembrie, «Sfântul Mucenic Aitala, diaconul».

death.note: As printed by days.pravoslavie.ru: “Мч. Аифала диакона, Персидского (380)”.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 1 сентября ст. ст. — «Мч. Аифала диакона, Персидского (380)»

attestations.note: The folder's Romanian row stood undocumented because doxologia.ro's list for 1 septembrie — the Russian calendar's day for him — does not name him; the Romanian calendar keeps him on 3 November with the bishop Acepsimas and the presbyter Joseph, and prints the three men's shared passion and their common troparion there. Read 25 September 2026.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 2 Σεπτεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Αειθαλάς και Αμών»

attestations.note: saint.gr has Aithalas and Amon of Adrianople killed with ox-hide whips under the prefect Babdos; the Russian calendar’s Aithalas is a deacon stoned in Persia in 380.
Not on the Православни подсетник’s calendar line for 14.09.2026 (1. септембар ст. ст.), nor in its Ohrid Prologue for that day (pravoslavno.rs, checked 2026-08-23).

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, Troparul Sfinților Sfințiți Mucenici Achepsima episcopul, Iosif preotul și Aitala diaconul, Glasul 4

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contests received incorruptible crowns from Thee our God; for possessing Thy strength they overthrew their torturers, and broke the feeble daring of the demons. By their prayers save Thou our souls, O Christ God.
